verdict.rationale: smolagents supports sharing/pushing agents to the Hugging Face Hub as Space repositories (push_to_hub/from_hub) and can execute code in sandboxed runtimes (Modal, E2B, Blaxel, Docker), which hints at deployment portability, but there is no documented mechanism for exposing a running agent as a callable API endpoint in a managed runtime. missing for 10: explicit API endpoint/service deployment docs, request/response contract, hosting instructions beyond code-sandboxing, and any hands-on confirmation of calling a deployed agent over HTTP.
